verdict.rationale: Quo is a US business phone and texting platform, so guided A2P 10DLC brand and campaign registration with approval-status tracking is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions 10DLC, brand or campaign registration, carrier compliance workflows, or registration status. The pack covers only the API, MCP, webhooks, pricing and calling features.

support.subject: As a founder, the product walks me through US A2P 10DLC brand and campaign registration and shows the approval status
